traits.name: How traits work
traits.effect: Equip the droid as your companion and scan it at a Trait Scanner Terminal. The game rolls a tier (Common, Gold, Diamond or Rainbow, 25% each), then a trait from that tier. A trait only works in its own slot. A reroll replaces the trait. Selling or fusing a droid loses its trait.

traits.name: Odds
traits.effect: Most droids: each Common, Gold or Diamond trait 2.27% (1 in 44), each Rainbow trait 1.56% (1 in 64). Iconic droids: 3.13% (1 in 32) and 2.27% (1 in 44). An Iconic's own trait is guaranteed by roll 60.

traits.name: Scan cost
traits.effect: An Iconic costs 200 Nova crystals per scan or reroll. Other droids cost credits: the first scan is 3 times the blueprint cost, and each reroll costs 25% more than the last, starting at the blueprint cost.

traits.name: After a Super Rebirth
traits.effect: Only Iconic droids keep their trait, tier and reroll count. Other droids reset.
